sections_in_order: Coverage Rationale (Cervical, Thoracic, Lumbar, Sacral sections)
CMS Related Documents (NCD/LCD/Article table by MAC; MAC state table)
criteria_location: There are no clinical criteria in this document. 'Coverage Rationale' (pp.1-3) states for each procedure whether an NCD exists, that LCDs/LCAs 'exist and compliance with these policies is required where applicable', and otherwise names a UHC commercial policy (Spinal Fusion and Decompression, Interspinous Fusion and Decompression Devices, Minimally Invasive Spine Surgery Procedures, ...) or InterQual. For lumbar spine surgery the only LCD is L37848 Lumbar Spinal Fusion (Palmetto, A56396 billing article); First Coast (Florida) has none listed.
procedures_covered: Interlaminar instrumented fusion (ILIF) with interspinous device
Percutaneous lumbar decompression of nucleus pulposus

extraction_hazards: Dense NCD/LCD/Article table with merged cells, 'Retired' notes and ** state footnotes flattens badly
Sections repeat one boilerplate pattern ('Medicare does not have an NCD ... LCDs/LCAs exist ...') for every procedure
Hyperlinks (Click here to view the InterQual criteria) carry the real content but are not in text
Page footers and 'Instructions for Use' legal text are long
interesting_structures: Pure delegation document: zero thresholds; the decision is made elsewhere (LCD, commercial policy, InterQual)
Jurisdiction table (MAC to states) that selects which LCD applies; Florida = First Coast, which has no lumbar LCD in this table

fit_to_tree.why: No criteria to put in a tree. A checker would need to follow the pointer to the commercial policy (itself InterQual-delegated) or a Palmetto LCD.
